name: Haruka Kanata
source:
A girl who, one day, popped right out of the monitor in Keiji's room.
She has a highly energetic, upbeat, and innocent personality, along with boundless curiosity.
According to her, the most fitting description for her existence is an "electronic lifeform," or to put it simply, an alien.
Although she possesses a flesh-and-blood physical body no different from a human's, her abilities allow her to do just about anything, from diving into monitors to freely manipulating electronic devices.
She is currently active as a virtual idol under the name "Haruka Kanata."
From [url=https://www.akabeesoft2.com/products/denshi_otome/index.html]Official Website[/url]
